correctness.rationale: The complete endomorphism block form follows from free generators and length-two products; the composition square condition reduces to T²=0 and ST+(T⊗T)S=0. J2/J1 module decompositions give dimension H=m³−m²r−mr²+2r³. The induced map from kerT/imT to kerU/imU is surjective and determines full rank r+r²+s, with each prescribed map admitting q^(H−ab) lifts. Gaussian counts of square-zero T and rank-s maps yield exactly the displayed polynomial. Direct exhaustive original-operator enumeration m=2 q=2,3 and all-T linear-system checks m=3 q=2,3 pass.
